name: Stack
description: Children one above the other, a step of the spacing scale apart (a flex column with a gap). Replaces hand-written space-y-* / flex flex-col gap-* wrappers.
usage: Vertical rhythm inside a card, a form, a dialog or a column body
`gap` takes the spacing scale's names: 2xs 8px, xs 12px, sm 16px, md 24px (default), lg 32px, xl 48px
Children stretch to the stack's width; give one `self-start` to keep its own width
design: A gap, never margins: a hidden or conditional child leaves no hole

props.name: as
props.description: The element; ul/ol for a list, whose children are then your li

props.name: className
props.description: On the element. Set the gap with `gap`, not a gap-* class: cn doesn't merge the named spacing classes, so both would apply

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Any other attribute (aria-label, data-*, id) goes on the element
